# Styles and combo trees

Inputs: L light, H heavy (hold 8 ticks), D after a dodge, P after a parry, J in the air, X a dash, G while guarding, T a throw. Frames are startup/active/recovery in ticks; the window is when the next input is taken after the active frames (0-0 ends the string). Every style builds on Academy taijutsu: paths a style leaves out keep the Academy move. Moves marked weapon_mult multiply the held weapon's damage.

## Academy taijutsu (`combat:style.academy_basics`, taijutsu)

Clean, balanced forms: the three-hit chain, a heavy, dodge and block. The base every style builds on. Who: everyone. Mentor: instructor. From beta1.
